title: Loyal
summary: LOY'AL, adjective [Latin lex, law.] Faithful to a prince or superior; true to plighted faith, duty or love; not treacherous; used of subjects to their prince, and of husband, wife and lovers; as a loy

inlines.v: LOY'AL, adjective [Latin lex, law.] Faithful to a prince or superior; true to plighted faith, duty or love; not treacherous; used of subjects to their prince, and of husband, wife and lovers; as a loyal subject; a loyal wife. There Laodamia with Evadne moves, unhappy both! but loyal in their loves.
